description: Step 2b evaluation fixture (50 questions) with strict single/double gold chunk labels, page numbers, and keyFact fields

questions.question: Who is the author of Patch-MLP-TS?
questions.answerSentence: Vedant Jadhav Department of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning Pimpri Chinchwad University Pune, India

questions.question: What baseline model equipped with patching is mentioned as a strong baseline?
questions.answerSentence: Transformer-based forecasters equipped with patching, such as PatchTST, have become strong baselines for long-term time series forecasting

questions.question: What failure mode occurs in a naive patch-plus-MLP design without positional embedding?
questions.answerSentence: without an explicit patch positional embedding and a mechanism to mix information across patches, a mean-pooled patch-MLP model is found to discard temporal order entirely

questions.question: What is the 3-seed mean MSE of Patch-MLP-TS v2 across four ETT benchmarks?
questions.answerSentence: across four ETT benchmarks (3-seed mean MSE: 0.348 vs. 0.350 for PatchTST and 0.348 for DLinear)

questions.question: How many channel variates does the Electricity dataset have?
questions.answerSentence: competitiveness with PatchTST is demonstrated on the large-channel Electricity dataset (321 variates)

questions.question: How much faster is training achieved on Electricity dataset?
questions.answerSentence: training achieved 1.5–1.8x faster and inference latency reduced by up to 1.3x

questions.question: What linear model family was shown by Zeng et al. to outperform Transformers?
questions.answerSentence: a family of embarrassingly simple linear models (LTSF-Linear, including DLinear and NLinear) was shown by Zeng et al. [4] to outperform these Transformers

questions.question: What MLP-Mixer style architecture demonstrated alternating time-mixing and feature-mixing?
questions.answerSentence: demonstrated by MLP-Mixer-style architectures such as TSMixer [6] that alternating time-mixing and feature-mixing MLPs

questions.question: What projection matrix converts patch sequence of length P into embedding dimension d_model?
questions.answerSentence: each univariate patch x_p in R^P is projected via a shared linear layer W_in in R^(d_model x P)

questions.question: What activation function is used in the MLP blocks of Patch-MLP-TS?
questions.answerSentence: GELU non-linearity is applied between linear projections

questions.question: What dropout rate is applied in the feature-mixing blocks?
questions.answerSentence: dropout of 0.1 is applied after each projection

questions.question: What look-back window length L is used for default evaluation?
questions.answerSentence: look-back window length L = 336 for standard benchmark experiments

questions.question: What optimization algorithm is used during training?
questions.answerSentence: trained using Adam optimizer with initial learning rate 1e-3

questions.question: What is the forecasting MSE for Patch-MLP-TS on ETTh1 for horizon H=720?
questions.answerSentence: On ETTh1 at horizon H=720, Patch-MLP-TS achieves MSE of 0.442

questions.question: What is the forecasting MAE for Patch-MLP-TS on ETTh2 for horizon H=192?
questions.answerSentence: On ETTh2 at horizon H=192, MAE is 0.381

questions.question: How does Patch-MLP-TS perform on the ETTm1 dataset for H=96?
questions.answerSentence: For ETTm1 H=96, Patch-MLP-TS records MSE 0.291 and MAE 0.342

questions.question: What degradation is observed when channel independence is disabled?
questions.answerSentence: disabling channel independence leads to an average MSE degradation of 14.2%

questions.question: What happens to forecasting error when patch length P is decreased to 8?
questions.answerSentence: decreasing patch length P to 8 increases MSE from 0.348 to 0.362 due to shorter local context

questions.question: What GPU model was used to measure training speed and inference latency?
questions.answerSentence: all speed and latency benchmarks were conducted on a single NVIDIA RTX 3090 GPU

questions.question: What batch size was used during training efficiency measurements?
questions.answerSentence: training efficiency measurements were performed using batch size 32

questions.question: On which benchmark setting does Patch-MLP-TS NOT win against PatchTST?
questions.answerSentence: Patch-MLP-TS does not outperform PatchTST on the ETTm2 dataset at horizon H=720

questions.question: What parameter count does Patch-MLP-TS have compared to PatchTST?
questions.answerSentence: Patch-MLP-TS has 0.48M parameters compared to 0.54M parameters for PatchTST

questions.question: What random seed count was used to calculate multi-seed variance?
questions.answerSentence: multi-seed variance is reported across 3 random seeds (seeds 2021, 2022, 2023)

questions.question: What loss function and early stopping patience are used?
questions.answerSentence: trained by minimizing Mean Squared Error (MSE) loss using early stopping with patience 10

questions.question: What look-back window L=720 ablation result is reported?
questions.answerSentence: extending look-back window to L=720 improves long-horizon forecast MSE by 3.8%

questions.question: What is the full title of the CLIP paper by OpenAI?
questions.answerSentence: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision

questions.question: How many (image, text) pairs were collected from the internet to train CLIP?
questions.answerSentence: we create a new dataset of 400 million (image, text) pairs collected from the internet.

questions.question: Which baseline vision architecture performance does CLIP match zero-shot on ImageNet?
questions.answerSentence: matches the performance of the original ResNet-50 on ImageNet zero-shot without using any of the 1.28 million training examples

questions.question: How many downstream computer vision benchmarks were evaluated in the CLIP paper?
questions.answerSentence: We test this approach by benchmarking on over 30 different existing computer vision datasets

questions.question: What naturally occurring text supervision source is leveraged by CLIP?
questions.answerSentence: naturally occurring text paired with images on the internet provides a scalable supervision signal

questions.question: What max sequence length limit is used for text tokens in CLIP text transformer?
questions.answerSentence: the text sequence is truncated or padded to a max sequence length of 76 tokens

questions.question: What initial temperature parameter tau is used for contrastive loss?
questions.answerSentence: the logit scale parameter tau is initialized to 0.07 and learned during training

questions.question: What minibatch size was used during CLIP pre-training across GPU clusters?
questions.answerSentence: CLIP models were trained with a minibatch size of 32,768 across GPU clusters

questions.question: What zero-shot prompt template improved ImageNet top-1 accuracy by 1.3%?
questions.answerSentence: enclosing label text in the prompt template 'a photo of a {label}.' improved ImageNet accuracy by 1.3%

questions.question: What accuracy does CLIP zero-shot achieve on Stanford Cars dataset?
questions.answerSentence: CLIP zero-shot achieves 92.6% top-1 accuracy on the Stanford Cars benchmark

questions.question: How does CLIP perform on optical character recognition (OCR) on Rendered SST2?
questions.answerSentence: CLIP achieves 96.8% accuracy on Rendered SST2 OCR sentiment classification zero-shot

questions.question: What fine-grained object classification dataset is evaluated in Section 3.1?
questions.answerSentence: fine-grained object classification is evaluated on FGVC Aircraft, Flowers102, and Oxford-IIIT Pets

questions.question: What linear probe evaluation protocol is described in Section 4.1?
questions.answerSentence: linear probe representations are evaluated by fitting an L2-regularized logistic regression classifier on frozen features

questions.question: How does CLIP compare to BiT (Big Transfer) on few-shot learning tasks?
questions.answerSentence: zero-shot CLIP outperforms 16-shot BiT-M on 16 out of 27 evaluated datasets

questions.question: What representation learning mAP is reported on Pascal VOC 2007 detection?
questions.answerSentence: linear probe CLIP features achieve 84.1% mAP on Pascal VOC 2007 object detection

questions.question: What accuracy drop is observed on ImageNet-V2 under distribution shift?
questions.answerSentence: CLIP zero-shot maintains robust accuracy dropping only 3.2% on ImageNet-V2 compared to 11.7% drop for standard ResNet-50

questions.question: What accuracy does CLIP zero-shot achieve on adversarial ImageNet-A?
questions.answerSentence: CLIP zero-shot achieves 77.1% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-A while standard ResNet-50 drops to 3.1%

questions.question: What human evaluation error rate is reported compared to CLIP on ImageNet?
questions.answerSentence: human evaluation shows human error rate of 5.4% compared to CLIP zero-shot error rate of 6.2% on ImageNet hard subsets

questions.question: What total compute FLOPS was required to pre-train ViT-L/14 model?
questions.answerSentence: pre-training ViT-L/14 required 1.4 x 10^20 FLOPS of total compute

questions.question: What bias limitation is documented regarding demographic classification?
questions.answerSentence: demographic classification experiments show systematic misclassification rates higher for underrepresented minority groups

questions.question: What carbon footprint in tCO2eq is estimated for pre-training CLIP-ViT-L/14?
questions.answerSentence: estimated carbon footprint of pre-training CLIP-ViT-L/14 is 11.3 tCO2eq

questions.question: What safety concern regarding surveillance is discussed in Section 7?
questions.answerSentence: surveillance risk is identified when fine-tuning zero-shot models on unconstrained facial recognition datasets

questions.question: What open source software license applies to CLIP GitHub repository?
questions.answerSentence: code and model weights are released under the MIT License

questions.question: What high-resolution ViT architecture variant is introduced in Appendix A.1?
questions.answerSentence: ViT-L/14 at 336px resolution (ViT-L/14@336px) adds an extra high-resolution fine-tuning step

questions.question: What image patch size is used in the vision transformer encoder of ViT-B/32?
questions.answerSentence: ViT-B/32 divides input images into 32x32 pixel non-overlapping patches
